# RhetorLint Claim Feedback

Canonical source: https://github.com/cambridgetcg/rhetorlint-spec/tree/main/examples/claim-feedback
Correction route: https://github.com/cambridgetcg/rhetorlint-spec/issues/new
Correction visibility: public, optional, and external to this Cloudflare door
Correction warning: do not submit private claim files or personal, sensitive,
or third-party material to the public issue tracker
Licence: MIT, as declared by the source repository

This Cloudflare origin serves reviewed static documentation, two closed JSON
schemas, one fictional example using reserved example.org URLs, a
machine-readable manifest, and exact release hashes.

It has no submission endpoint, Worker or Pages Function, server-side claim
processor, crawler, fetcher, storage binding, analytics code, model call,
KARMA signer, dataset writer, timer, or background loop. Run the complete
builder locally from the canonical source repository.

RhetorLint marks visible wording patterns. It does not decide truth, lies,
intent, ego, motive, character, or person worth. The supplied crawl receipt is
not authenticated. Robots access is not copyright, privacy, reuse, or AI
training permission. Public availability does not prove dataset selection,
training, model update, removal, or correction uptake.

Machine doors:
- /.well-known/claim-feedback.json
- /contracts/claim-feedback-input.schema.json
- /contracts/claim-feedback-packet.schema.json
- /examples/corrected-claim.json
- /release-lock.json
